connector.name: Zoteus
connector.registryDescription: The everything Zotero MCP server - Web API v3 + local API, safe writes, citations, search.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.zoteus.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package zoteus. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oscardvs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY
env.description: Zotero API key (writes/sync/groups; optional for local-only reads).

env.name: ZOTEUS_LOCAL
env.description: Use the Zotero desktop local API: auto | on | off.

env.name: ZOTEUS_ALLOW_DELETE
env.description: Set to true to enable permanent deletion (off by default).
